notes: N097. BSCCM never measures two single markers on one cell, so lineages are defined per single-stain slide of the TEST draw: positives = label above the 2-component GMM valley (CD16) or above max(valley, median + 3 MAD) for the rare-positive markers (evaluation only). Model = N085 record ensemble E8 (GOAL .6967), both directions. a mean predicted z-score (z over all test cells of a direction, averaged over the 2 directions) of every marker on the true positives of each lineage: T cells get high predicted CD3 and low CD19/CD14/CD16, monocytes high CD14/HLA-DR, CD16+ cells (neutrophils) high CD16; B cells are not cleanly separated from T cells. b, c predicted CD3 vs CD19 on true T (CD3+ on the CD3 slide) and true B (CD19+ on the CD19 slide) cells, b = train draw 1 -> test draw 0 (b10), c = b01 (counts {('b01', 'B (CD19+ slide)'): 10, ('b01', 'CD19- (CD19 slide)'): 712, ('b01', 'CD3- (CD3 slide)'): 2276, ('b01', 'T (CD3+ slide)'): 692, ('b10', 'B (CD19+ slide)'): 39, ('b10', 'CD19- (CD19 slide)'): 1260, ('b10', 'CD3- (CD3 slide)'): 540, ('b10', 'T (CD3+ slide)'): 89}); in c 67 of 692 measured-CD3+ cells get predicted CD19 z > 2 and predicted HLA-DR above the other T cells, spread over 63 of 249 fields of view with clearly positive CD3 labels (median 1.67) -> a model error (B-like T cells), not a field-of-view label artefact. d AUROC: each marker detects its own positives (CD3 .99/.86, CD14 .98/.97, CD16 .97/.97; CD19 .83/.87, CD123 .87/.86 for b10/b01); B vs T by predicted CD19 - CD3 .95 (b10, 39 B vs 89 T) and .70 (b01, only 10 B vs 692 T). e correlation of the predicted CD3 and CD19 outputs: positive over all cells (both are lymphocyte markers, +.23/+.18), negative within gated lymphocytes (-.54, draw 0 only) and within true T+B cells in b10 (-.49), ~0 in b01 (+.01). f B vs T AUROC for the record ensemble and each of its 8 members (rings = directions; R50 = ResNet-50, comp. = composite heads, CNX-S = ConvNeXt-S).
